content.text: My Favourites (0) AddGet BeinlanguageENESEditionUnited StatesbeIN XTRAManage NotificationsContact UsTV GuideHome > Soccer > FIFA World Cup > Turkey vs Romania (VIDEO): all goals from UEFA playoff semifinalTurkey vs Romania (VIDEO): all goals from UEFA playoff semifinal03/26/2026 - 04:50 PM - by Miguel CalixtoThe UEFA playoffs for the 2026 World Cup are underway, and the clash between Turkey and Romania kicks off the race for the remaining qualification spots.The match takes place at Tüpraş Stadium as both teams aim to move one step closer to the tournament in the United States, Mexico, and Canada. Goals from Turkey vs Romania Turkey goal 53' Ferdi Kadıoğlu defines after a fantastic pass from Arda Güler Ferdi Kadıoğlu opens the scoring for Türkiye !🇹🇷 Türkiye 1-0 Romania 🇷🇴pic.twitter.com/pEFwat2noH— StatPad Football📊📈📉 (@StatPadFootball) March 26, 2026 Who will Turkey or Romania face next? The winner of this semifinal will face the winner between Slovakia and Kosovo.The final is scheduled for March 31, where the World Cup spot will be decided.If the match ends in a draw, it will go to extra time and penalties.
